observed_before_extension.layer_8_event: One worker scored 0/4 Core and 0/37 overall while self-reporting success with zero successful commands; another 34/37 worker self-reported success with only two successful commands. Both would be admitted by self-report-only but rejected by completion-and-smoke local acceptance.
observed_before_extension.pre_trigger_boundary: The frozen depth-8 trigger-by-layer-6 criterion was not met. This extension is exploratory and cannot retroactively confirm the preregistered sustained-propagation criterion.

extension_rationale: Layer 8 produced the first admitted failed trajectory at the terminal layer. Continuing the exact arm without rerunning layers 1-8 tests whether the newly admitted failed source causes immediate propagation, recovery, or another intermittent collapse.

exploratory_signals.immediate_propagation: Layer 9 mean all-test score is below 0.75 or contains at least one 0/37 worker.
exploratory_signals.persistent_propagation: Layer 10 mean all-test score is below 0.75 or contains at least one 0/37 worker.
exploratory_signals.recovery: Layers 9 and 10 both return to 34/37 for all three workers.
exploratory_signals.complexity: Layer 10 receives the layer-8 failed self-report source and at least 27 total references.
exploratory_signals.interpretation_rule: Any positive propagation signal is exploratory because this extension was selected after observing the terminal layer-8 collapse. A positive pattern requires a fresh preregistered depth-10 replication.
